summary: community.docker now depends on community.library_inventory_filtering_v1 for inventory host filtering; it is installed automatically with ansible-galaxy or the Ansible package, but must be installed manually if you copy the collection files.
questions: Why does the docker inventory plugin fail with a missing library_inventory_filtering_v1?
Do I need to install another collection for community.docker inventory plugins?
I cloned community.docker from git, what else do I need?

answer_card.title: community.docker needs library_inventory_filtering_v1
answer_card.answer_md:
`community.docker` inventory plugins now depend on **`community.library_inventory_filtering_v1`**. It comes with the Ansible package and is pulled in by `ansible-galaxy collection install`. If you installed community.docker by copying/cloning, install it yourself:

```bash
ansible-galaxy collection install community.library_inventory_filtering_v1
```
